edits.before: Skill

edits.after: E unlocks E-Q flux clears, but his DoT shove still out-ranges you — clear from distance and concede priority.

edits.after: Malzahar

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: His 6 is the scarier one: Nether Grasp is point-and-click suppression. Hold Flash, ward both sides, warp only to escape or roam.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. It governs your forward steps. - W Rune Prison spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Nether Grasp: 140/110/80s — point-and-click suppression; never step up solo while it and Void Shift are up. Its downtime governs your forward steps. - His Q silence sits on a flat 6s. - W Rune Prison (11s) spent on poke is a death you scheduled — it also cancels his R channeled on a teammate.

edits.before: Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Every 1000-range Q is a free deposit — Tear stacks fund the two-item spike that flips this lane, so cast on cooldown whenever it costs nothing.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: When Call of the Void whiffs he has no silence for 6s — step in, land the E-Q flux chunk, and back off before it returns.

edits.before: That’s Malzahar’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Pre-items you lose every sustained exchange to his DoTs and Void Shift.

edits.before: Your root is your only 'stop' button — a W spent poking is a Zed mark you can't answer.
edits.after: His E DoT ticks in full once you step up — your 1000-range Q takes the same minion for free.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: His Q silence eats your answer if you pre-cast — hold W until he commits, and remember it cancels his R on a teammate.

edits.before: Track Malzahar’s Nether Grasp: Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Nether Grasp is point-and-click — never step up solo while it and Void Shift are up. If he suppresses a teammate, your Rune Prison root cancels the channel instantly.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP extends the same plan. Nothing else is defensible on him.

edits.before: At 6 Nether Grasp suppresses through your W and shield for a guaranteed gank, his biggest edge.
edits.after: At 6 point-and-click Nether Grasp suppresses you before W can answer, setting up a gank — his biggest edge.

edits.before: With two items and QSS to break Nether Grasp, your sustained Q-E-Q and passive shield let you dive and kill him before his DoTs and pool win the trade.
edits.after: With two items and QSS to break Nether Grasp, your sustained E-Q rotations and deep mana pool let you dive and kill him before his DoTs win the trade.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 stay grim — the shove never stops, so you lose CS and roam tempo, and at 6 his Nether Grasp point-blank suppresses you through your Rune Prison and shield to set up a lethal gank. Hold your flash for his all-in and ward both sides. Your Realm Warp at 6 is only useful to escape or roam, not to contest the 1v1.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 stay grim — the shove never stops, so you lose CS and roam tempo, and at 6 his point-and-click Nether Grasp suppresses you before Rune Prison can answer, setting up a lethal gank. Hold Flash for his all-in and ward both sides. Your Realm Warp at 6 is only useful to escape or roam, not to contest the 1v1.

edits.before: Once your mana items arrive you match his shove with double-Q and Spell Flux, and the lane finally reads even to favored. With QSS to break Nether Grasp and two items of scaling, your sustained Q-E-Q plus passive shield lets you dive through his DoTs and kill him outright — this is where your scaling overtakes his lane-bully phase.
edits.after: Once your mana items arrive you match his shove with double-Q and Spell Flux, and the lane finally reads even to favored. edits.after: Wait for two items before trying to all-in through his Void Shift passive
